title: Saturn Hexagon Mystery Explained

scenes.text: Saturn's six‑sided storm spans 30,000 km around the pole.
Many believe the hexagon is a solid, floating wall of ice.
scenes.label: Hexagon is a solid wall

scenes.text: In reality, it's a persistent jet stream—fast winds creating a stable hexagonal wave pattern.
scenes.label: Jet stream creates shape

scenes.text: Fast winds, not solid matter, shape Saturn’s hexagon.
scenes.label: Wind‑shaped pattern
scenes.sub: A planetary jet stream can lock into a six‑sided vortex.

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: The iconic hexagon around Saturn’s pole isn’t a solid structure—it’s a massive, stable jet stream. Follow for daily science!
